prBodyNotes: Read the engine release notes before merging.

packageRules.description: A major engine release, step 1: the ops and drift callers, because a dispatched run uses the ops caller on main
packageRules.groupName: tf-pr-ops engine major (1 of 2, ops and drift callers)
packageRules.commitMessageTopic: the tf-pr-ops engine ops and drift callers
prBodyNotes: Step 1 of 2 of a major engine bump. Read the release notes: a major can need caller edits beyond the version, and they go in this pull request. Merge this one first; step 2 moves the PR and unlock callers.

packageRules.description: A major engine release, step 2: the PR and unlock callers, after step 1 is on main
packageRules.groupName: tf-pr-ops engine major (2 of 2, PR and unlock callers)
packageRules.commitMessageTopic: the tf-pr-ops engine PR and unlock callers
prBodyNotes: Step 2 of 2 of a major engine bump. Merge step 1 (the ops and drift callers) first. Until it is on main, the pre-commit job here fails the engine pin check on purpose; Renovate rebases this branch once step 1 merges, and the check passes.
